title: Сложные формы герундия и причастия: having done, being done

why: Эти формы позволяют уложить два действия в одно предложение и показать, какое из них было раньше или кто его совершил. В русском для этого есть деепричастия («сделав», «будучи уволенным»), в английском — причастие и герундий с having / being.
formation: • Perfect participle (действие раньше главного): having + V3 (третья форма глагола) — Having finished, ...
• Пассив: being + V3 (действие идёт или состояние) / having been + V3 (действие произошло раньше) — Being asked..., Having been asked...
• Perfect gerund: having + V3 — He denied having seen her.
• Passive gerund: being + V3 / having been + V3 — I hate being interrupted.
• Отрицание: not стоит перед формой — Not having received an answer, ... / He regrets not having asked.
usage: 1. Одно действие закончилось, потом началось другое (подлежащее одно и то же): Having finished the report, I went home. (Закончив отчёт, я пошёл домой.)
2. Причина действия: Not having received a reply, she wrote again. (Не получив ответа, она написала снова.)
3. Пассивное причастие: Having been fired, he started his own company. (Будучи уволенным, он открыл свою компанию.) Being left alone, the child began to cry. (Оставшись один, ребёнок заплакал.)

4. Perfect gerund после глаголов и предлогов, когда действие было раньше: She admitted having made a mistake. (Она призналась, что сделала ошибку.) He was proud of having won. (Он гордился тем, что победил.)
5. Passive gerund: I don't like being told what to do. (Не люблю, когда мне указывают, что делать.)
signalWords: deny, admit, regret, remember, apologize for, accuse of, thank for, be proud of, be ashamed of, because / since / after (вместо них можно поставить having + V3).
mistakes: ✗ Finished the work, he went home → ✓ Having finished the work, he went home (русское деепричастие «закончив» требует having).
✗ Having tired, she sat down → ✓ Being tired, she sat down (having + V3 нужно для действия, а не для состояния).
✗ Having read the instructions, the printer started → ✓ Having read the instructions, I started the printer (подлежащее главной части должно совпадать с тем, кто совершил первое действие).
✗ He denied to have seen her → ✓ He denied having seen her (после deny, admit, regret — герундий).
remember: Having + V3 = «сделав» (раньше), being + V3 = «будучи сделанным» (пассив), и подлежащее у обоих действий одно.

exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в нужную форму (having done / being done)

items.prompt: ___ (finish) the report, she sent it to the manager.
items.answer: Having finished

items.prompt: ___ (not / receive) any answer, he called again.
items.answer: Not having received

items.prompt: He denied ___ (steal) the laptop.
items.answer: having stolen / stealing

items.prompt: I hate ___ (interrupt) when I'm coding.
items.answer: being interrupted

items.prompt: ___ (live) in Kyiv for ten years, he knew the city well.
items.answer: Having lived

items.prompt: She was proud of ___ (promote) so quickly.
items.answer: having been promoted / being promoted

items.prompt: ___ (see) the film twice, we didn't want to go again.
items.answer: Having seen

items.prompt: He doesn't like ___ (tell) what to do.
items.answer: being told

items.prompt: (a) Finished (b) Having finished the code, he pushed it to GitHub.
items.answer: (b) Having finished

items.prompt: She admitted (a) to take (b) having taken the key.
items.answer: (b) having taken

items.prompt: (a) Having tired (b) Being tired, he made a lot of mistakes.
items.answer: (b) Being tired

items.prompt: He was angry about (a) ignoring (b) being ignored by his team.
items.answer: (b) being ignored

items.prompt: (a) Having been fired (b) Having fired, he started his own company.
items.answer: (a) Having been fired

items.prompt: I'm sorry for (a) having kept (b) to have kept you waiting.
items.answer: (a) having kept

items.prompt: (a) Having wrote (b) Having written the email, she closed her laptop.
items.answer: (b) Having written

items.prompt: Nobody likes (a) laughing at (b) being laughed at.
items.answer: (b) being laughed at

exercises.instruction: Объедините предложения, используя having done / being done / having been done

items.prompt: She finished her work. Then she went home. (Begin with: Having)
items.answer: Having finished her work, she went home.

items.prompt: He didn't read the manual. He couldn't set up the router. (Begin with: Not having)
items.answer: Not having read the manual, he couldn't set up the router.

items.prompt: We had checked all the options. We chose the cheapest. (Begin with: Having)
items.answer: Having checked all the options, we chose the cheapest.

items.prompt: He had been warned about the traffic, so he left early. (Begin with: Having been)
items.answer: Having been warned about the traffic, he left early.

items.prompt: She was sorry that she had lost the files. (Use: sorry for ...)
items.answer: She was sorry for having lost the files.

items.prompt: He denied that he had broken the window. (Use: denied + gerund)
items.answer: He denied having broken the window.

items.prompt: I don't like it when people shout at me. (Use: I don't like + gerund)
items.answer: I don't like being shouted at.

items.prompt: After he had been given the keys, he opened the door. (Begin with: Having been)
items.answer: Having been given the keys, he opened the door.

items.prompt: Finished the test, the students left the room.
items.answer: Having finished the test, the students left the room.

items.prompt: Having tired, he went to bed early.
items.answer: Being tired, he went to bed early.

items.prompt: He denied to have seen her.
items.answer: He denied having seen her. / He denied seeing her.

items.prompt: Having read the instructions, the printer started working. (the printer didn't read them)
items.answer: Having read the instructions, I started the printer.

items.prompt: I remember to be told about it last week.
items.answer: I remember being told about it last week.

items.prompt: She was proud of be chosen as team lead.
items.answer: She was proud of being chosen as team lead.

items.prompt: Not have finished the project, he asked for more time.
items.answer: Not having finished the project, he asked for more time.

items.prompt: They apologized for have been late.
items.answer: They apologized for being late. / They apologized for having been late.

items.prompt: Закончив код, я отправил его на ревью.
items.answer: Having finished the code, I sent it for review.

items.prompt: Не получив ответа, она написала ему снова.
items.answer: Not having received an answer, she wrote to him again.

items.prompt: Он отрицал, что видел этого клиента.
items.answer: He denied having seen this client. / He denied seeing this client.

items.prompt: Терпеть не могу, когда меня прерывают на встречах.
items.answer: I hate being interrupted in meetings.

items.prompt: Прожив в Лондоне пять лет, она хорошо говорила по-английски.
items.answer: Having lived in London for five years, she spoke English well.

items.prompt: Будучи уволенным, он открыл собственную компанию.
items.answer: Having been fired, he started his own company.

items.prompt: Она гордится тем, что её выбрали лидером команды.
items.answer: She is proud of having been chosen team leader. / She is proud of being chosen team leader.

items.prompt: Извините, что заставил вас ждать.
items.answer: Sorry for keeping you waiting. / I'm sorry for having kept you waiting.
